name: Nabljudatel'
source:
A story about rough childhood, delusions, and the rose-tinted glasses, that are to be broken with the shards facing inside.

Our heroine is faced with the heritage of an old house in a rural village, where she lived during younger days. It was decided to sell the house, that had only childhood memories in it's walls. But such a simple task turns out the wrong way. The house is being watched...or rather she is being stalked?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069310/]Steam[/url]]
